title: Mahalanobis Distance Multivariate Outlier Detection
description: Distance metric accounting for covariance structures among correlated continuous features.
conditions: Multivariate continuous numerical dataset with strong correlations between features
Underlying data approximates an elliptical multivariate normal distribution
Sample size N significantly exceeds number of features P (N >> P)
recommended_methods: Mahalanobis distance calculation using empirical covariance matrix
Minimum Covariance Determinant (MCD) for robust covariance estimation (Rousseeuw)
Chi-Square distribution thresholding with degrees of freedom equal to number of features
selection_rules: Always use Robust Mahalanobis (MCD) rather than classical Mahalanobis to prevent outlier contamination of the covariance matrix
Compare squared Mahalanobis distance against Chi-Square critical value at p = 0.001
Do not use Mahalanobis distance if covariance matrix is singular or non-invertible
limitations: Assumes unimodal elliptical distribution; fails on multimodal or manifold geometries
Cannot invert covariance matrix if P > N or if collinear features exist
source: Rousseeuw and Driessen (1999) A Fast Algorithm for the Minimum Covariance Determinant Estimator
